summary: Risk-off conditions dominate markets today: Bitcoin fell roughly 6% toward $75,000 after a technology-stock selloff, while more than $1 billion in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated, overwhelmingly from longs.[1][2][4] Ethereum and Solana also declined sharply, and stronger-than-expected U.S. employment data pushed Treasury yields higher, adding pressure to risk assets.[6][9] The available same-day results do not verify fresh calls from the named trader accounts, so unverified analyst-specific signals are omitted.

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reason: Bitcoin fell about 6% and tested approximately $74,781 as technology-stock weakness, ETF outflows, and long liquidations intensified selling.[1][2][4]
signals.source: Market coverage citing Binance, CoinGlass, and ETF-flow data

signals.reason: Ethereum fell more than 7% toward $2,240 while roughly 81% of its reported liquidations were long positions.[4][6]
